Despite the Butterfish's description, it is only used in one cooking recipe: [[Glazed Butterfish]]. {{TOC|limit=2}} ==Map== {|class="wikitable" |style="background-color:unset;"|[[File:Fish Zone Shearwater Bridge.png|center|500px|class=responsive-image]] || style="background-color:unset;"|[[File:Fish Zone Forest West.png|center|500px|class=responsive-image]] |- |style="text-align:center;"|Shearwater Bridge - Fish Zones || style="text-align:center;"|Forest West - Fish Zones |} {{clear}} ==Gifting== {{PAGENAME}} is a universally '''disliked''' gift item, with the following exceptions: {{Gifting |love= Andy, Gus, Victor, Willy |like= Claire, Olivia, Lance |neutral= Demetrius, Henchman, Leo, Linus, Morgan |hate= Abigail, Clint, Evelyn, George, Haley, Jas, Martin, Maru, Pam, Scarlett, Sebastian, Shane, Sophia, Vincent }} ==Fish Pond== {{#lst:Fish|Butterfish}} ==Recipes== ===Cooking=== {{Recipes|header}} {{:Glazed Butterfish|RecipeRow}} {{Recipes|Footer}} ==Bundles== When '''"SVE Bundles"''' is selected in the [[Configuration Options]], {{PAGENAME}} is required to complete the {{Bundle|specialty fish|32|y}}. If '''"Hard SVE Bundles"''' is selected, 3 Butterfish are required to complete the bundle. ==Quests== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any quests. ==Tailoring== {{DyePot|Yellow}} When used in dyeing, {{PAGENAME}} produces a yellow color. {{Navbox Fish}} [[Category:Fish]] [[zh:鲳鱼]]
